objective: Neutral end-to-end proof that the proven Scheduled Runtime mailbox-pool transport is correctly bound to an actual Agent Control Plane task/request/execution fence, exact mechanical GitHub persistence, stale-attempt rejection, terminal completion ordering, and gateway release. No persistent Agent is reinstantiated.
scope: lvlaksim1/agent-control-plane-gateway@main lease for this bounded neutral proof only
fresh disabled Scheduled Task mailboxes and one-shot neutral execution-worker producers created only for this proof
constraints: Do not reinstate any persistent Agent.
Keep recurring Wake Broker and Execution Worker disabled.
Do not modify any client project.
Scheduled producer runtimes may only read scheduler metadata and write their specifically assigned disabled mailbox task.

Every relay must bind exact task_id, request_digest, request_blob_sha, logical_attempt, execution_id/generation, author_id, producer_task_id, mailbox_task_id/generation, admission_nonce and payload digest.
Any mailbox known to a lost or suspect producer is quarantined and must not be reassigned.
Retry uses a different physical mailbox and a higher logical_attempt.
Persist exact authored relay bytes to GitHub without semantic reinterpretation.
Complete state only after durable relay/result verification; release gateway only after completed-state re-read.
